rossa.name: Kapitänin Rossa
rossa.desc: adult woman, mid-thirties. tall, sturdy. hair: dark red, straight, jaw-length, worn loose. brown eyes, warm medium skin tone, sharp cheekbones, no facial hair. Signature: a long dark green oilskin coat worn open over her pirate outfit. Clothing: a black linen collarless wide-sleeved pirate shirt, dark brown wide-leg linen trousers cut to mid-calf, black leather buckle boots to the ankle, a wide red leather belt at the waist, a long dark green oilskin coat worn open over the top

dragon.name: Drachenmutter
dragon.desc: dragon, large forest dragon. large — the body mass of a draft horse, four-legged, with two broad membranous wings folded against the flanks when at rest. deep forest-green scales across the body shading to dark charcoal on the back ridges, soft pale grey-green on the underbelly; two eyes that glow amber-gold like candlelight. large fan-shaped ears that lie flat when wary, a blunt rounded snout with wide nostrils, a heavy tail tapering to a rounded tip, wing membranes a translucent dark olive-green with visible vein ridges, no spines or horns — smooth rounded head
